entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand tracker. It's useless and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF-8675309. I've had it for a few weeks and I'm done with it. I expect a full refund.
Thank you, Sam. I have your order right here. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's my preference to not own this piece of junk! I don't need a reason. And don't you dare tell me it's 'too late' or give me some made-up rule about hygiene. Your website has a return policy and you're going to honor it.
I completely understand your frustration, Sam. I just need to confirm the purchase date to check the return eligibility. One moment while I review your order details.
Hurry up. If I don't get a return label by the end of this call, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. My brother is a lawyer.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I see here that the item was delivered 29 days ago. Our current policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. Concerns about sanitation don't apply this early in the ownership period. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
Oh. You're... you're just going to approve it? Seriously?

Yes, of course. You're well within the timeframe stated in our policy. I've just initiated the return process. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address we have on file. Just print that out, affix it to the original packaging, and drop it off with the carrier.
Wow. Okay. I was expecting a whole big fight. So I just send it back and I get my money?

That's correct. Once our warehouse receives and inspects the item, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sam?
No... no, that's it. That was... surprisingly easy. Thanks, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
